name: Haus Bettina
beschreibung:
Scenicly situated in the village of Ladis, Haus Bettina offers welcoming rooms and apartments showcasing delightful alpine panoramas. It provides an ideal retreat for summer and winter holidays.

The Sonnenbahn Ladis-Fiss lift connecting to the vast ski arena and hiking paths are only moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Bettina in Ladis provides sunny comfort close to the historic Castle Laudeck.
